annotations.title: Upload a file into a sandbox

description: Write a file into the sandbox at an absolute `path` (parent directories are created). Give `content` for UTF-8 text OR `content_base64` for binary. Limit 5 MB per file inline — for bigger files call `get_upload_url` and PUT the bytes to the link (no base64 through this chat). Optional `mode` like "755". Requires: token + live sandbox_id. Max 5 MB.

content.description: Optional. File content as UTF-8 text. Give either `content` or `content_base64` (default: empty file).

content_base64.description: Optional. File content as base64 for binary files, up to 5 MB decoded. Use instead of `content`.

mode.description: Optional. File permissions in octal, 3–4 digits, e.g. "644" or "755". Default: the sandbox default.

path.description: Required. Absolute path inside the sandbox to write; parent directories are created, e.g. "/root/app/main.py". Must start with "/".

sandbox_id.description: Required. Sandbox id as returned by create_sandbox / list_sandboxes, e.g. "sb_3f2a…".

name: upload_file
title: Upload a file into a sandbox
